method.calibration: Provisional Print Run Lab estimate. Median of the numbered non-autograph Base Sapphire tiers that carry official Topps NumberedTo serials. Autographs are excluded from calibration by design. Assumes stated serial ceilings are substantially represented in the Hobby format. Estimates are conditional and provisional, not manufacturer-confirmed production totals, and are not calibrated.
method.gate_override_justification: min_anchor_odds_denominator relaxed from the default 20 to 9 so all five numbered Base Sapphire tiers (Aqua 1:10, Green 1:9, Orange 1:11, Purple 1:22, Red 1:54) qualify as anchors. The five tiers agree on implied packs within 1.8% (max_anchor_spread 0.0182 vs the 0.05 gate), and the Print Run Lab offline calibration against owner targets returned PASS at +1.86% relative error (n=1, provisional, not-yet-calibrated). The category==='Base', serial_limit>1 and max_anchor_spread gates are unchanged; Padparadscha /1 stays excluded (serial 1).
method.excluded_from_calibration: One-of-ones (Padparadscha serial 1), all autograph tiers, the owner-sheet-unconfirmed ordinary autograph serial, and the unnumbered ordinary Base cards (odds not published). All non-selected numbered tiers are retained as diagnostics, not forced to agree.

replaces_source.reason: Owner-approved replacement of two legacy unsourced 'Reported' rows (Auto 200, Base 1900) with the reviewed Print Run Lab schema-1 calculation. The legacy rows carry no source and are not authoritative; the 1900 figure is explicitly not a source per the Lab artifact.

calibration_report.note: Offline comparison against owner targets only; n=1; not manufacturer confirmation and not a change to publication eligibility. Data remains provisional and not-yet-calibrated.
